mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fellow of the Royal Society of Health London."
Idowu is a fellow of the Royal Society of Health London.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person with the responsibilities and powers to facilitate, arbitrate, preside over, and make decisions and directions in regard to the application of the law."
A judicial officer is a person with the responsibilities and powers to facilitate, arbitrate, preside over, and make decisions and directions in regard to the application of the law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those one possesses as a citizen; human rights are possessed by virtue of being human."
Civil rights are those one possesses as a citizen; human rights are possessed by virtue of being human.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which a law is made by a legislative body or a body empowered by law to make laws."
Law making or law making process is the process by which a law is made by a legislative body or a body empowered by law to make laws.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document that invites a person to attend a court session at a particular time to answer to a specific charge brought by a named party."
A Summon is a document that invites a person to attend a court session at a particular time to answer to a specific charge brought by a named party.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body of law that relates to crime."
Criminal Law is the body of law that relates to crime.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an order on all policemen, private persons and every Nigerian to hold the body, restrain and put in confinement, the person so named in the warrant for the purpose of bringing him to court."

A warrant of arrest is an order on all policemen, private persons and every Nigerian to hold the body, restrain and put in confinement, the person so named in the warrant for the purpose of bringing him to court.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the part of the law that deals mainly with the relationship between individuals."
Private law is the part of the law that deals mainly with the relationship between individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variant of the warrant of arrest which deals most principally on arresting a person who is in contempt of court."
Note the bench warrant is a variant of the warrant of arrest which deals most principally on arresting a person who is in contempt of court.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as any failure of the accused to exercise reasonable care that has resulted in the injury of another or has caused or capable of causing threat to the health and safety of another."

Negligence can be defined as any failure of the accused to exercise reasonable care that has resulted in the injury of another or has caused or capable of causing threat to the health and safety of another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the laws made by the National Assembly (the Senate and the House of Representatives) and they have national effect if they border on matters within the exclusive and concurrent legislative list."

Acts of the National Assembly are the laws made by the National Assembly (the Senate and the House of Representatives) and they have national effect if they border on matters within the exclusive and concurrent legislative list.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chief law enforcement officer of the federal or of a state government, typically serving in an executive branch position."
She/he is the chief law enforcement officer of the federal or of a state government, typically serving in an executive branch position.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a source of public health laws because human rights guarantee the right to life, health and healthy environment."
Human rights law is a source of public health laws because human rights guarantee the right to life, health and healthy environment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major source of public and environmental law because it provides a lot of laws and policies that are aimed at protecting the environment and by extension public health."
International law is a major source of public and environmental law because it provides a lot of laws and policies that are aimed at protecting the environment and by extension public health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sole statutory body that is vested with the responsibility of standardising and regulating the quality of all products in Nigeria."
The Standard Organisation of Nigeria is the sole statutory body that is vested with the responsibility of standardising and regulating the quality of all products in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a person authorised to make decisions."
Judge refers to a person authorised to make decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a defence for most criminal offences under Section 24 of Criminal Code (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003)."
Accident is a defence for most criminal offences under Section 24 of Criminal Code (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an issue under the exclusive legislative list of the 1999 Constitution (Item 57, 2nd Schedule; Part 1) and under the sheriffs and civil process act (Cap S.6 LFN 2004, S. 96)."

The service of processes is an issue under the exclusive legislative list of the 1999 Constitution (Item 57, 2nd Schedule; Part 1) and under the sheriffs and civil process act (Cap S.6 LFN 2004, S. 96).
